example: Instead of instructing the user to run 'drop table public.learnings;' followed by 'create table ...' in a new snippet to add the 'source' column, the agent should have proposed 'alter table public.learnings add column source text not null default '''USER''';' within their existing schema query snippet.
insight: Propose non-destructive schema migrations (like 'ALTER TABLE') instead of destructive recreation ('DROP TABLE') when resolving database mismatches during prototyping. Actionable insight: Add a new guideline to the entities.md resource file of feature-architect-plan to check schema alterations and recommend non-destructive ALTER TABLE commands and snippet reuse instead of destructive table drop/re-creation.
